Ready for the maintainer to merge.

The page meets issue #2423. The Install page and FAQ link to the new page within their articles. The guidance separates reported results from tested support. The backend options and stderr capture agree with the current source.

Local results on macOS, against upstream/main `3e47b898b0148727979ff4a509f33a742f80ff1d`:

- Trial merge: clean. The PR already contains this main commit.
- `test_windows_troubleshooting.py`: 3 tests passed.
- `test_guide_navigation.py`: 5 tests passed, including internal links and anchors.
- `zola --root site build`: passed; 46 pages and 10 sections.
- `cargo xtask gate quick --base upstream/main --dry-run`: no Rust steps selected.
- `cargo xtask gate quick --base upstream/main`: passed; 0 steps, 0 failures.
- `git diff --check upstream/main...HEAD`: passed.

The first gate-tool build stalled with sccache. I stopped that build. The tool compiled and the gate passed with sccache disabled.

No Rust crate changed, so crate tests and clippy do not apply. This PR changes no posted G-code, safety check, stock simulation, geometry, UI code, or golden file. Safety mutation checks and UI screenshots do not apply. I did not run mutation tests.

Requested changes: none.

Windows startup, hardware checks, ARM execution, and VM execution were not tested on this host.

A maintainer will approve and merge by hand.
